# InputGroup

An input with fixed text, an icon or one button attached to its sides: units, prefixes, a search action.

```tsx
import { InputGroup } from '@kafka/react'
```

## When to use it

- Units and fixed text the reader should not type: "https://", "COP", "por persona".
- One action that belongs to the field: Buscar, Copiar, Aplicar.
- Always inside a `Field`, so the label names the input.

## When not to

- Instructions or the field's name in the addon: that is the label's job.
- More than one button.
- Addons that change meaning (a currency picker): use a Select next to the field.

## Examples

### Text and icon addons

The addon is part of the look, not of the name: the `Field` label still names the input. Use it for units, prefixes and fixed text ("https://", "COP"), not for instructions.

```tsx
<div className="flex max-w-md flex-col gap-4">
  <Field label="Sitio web">
    <InputGroup prefix="https://" suffix=".com">
      <Input placeholder="mi-sitio" />
    </InputGroup>
  </Field>
  <Field label="Precio del taller">
    <InputGroup prefix="COP" suffix="por persona">
      <Input inputMode="numeric" placeholder="200000" />
    </InputGroup>
  </Field>
</div>
```

### With an action

A button at the end for one action that belongs to the field: search, copy, apply. The button is named by its own text.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md">
  <Field label="Buscar en la biblioteca">
    <InputGroup action={<Button variant="soft">Buscar</Button>}>
      <Input placeholder="Título o autor" />
    </InputGroup>
  </Field>
</div>
```

### With an icon addon

Icon addons are decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

```tsx
<div className="max-w-md">
  <Field label="Ciudad">
    <InputGroup prefixIcon={IconSearch}>
      <Input placeholder="Cali" />
    </InputGroup>
  </Field>
</div>
```

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `prefix` | `string` |  | Fixed text before the input: "https://", "COP". |
| `suffix` | `string` |  | Fixed text after the input: ".com", "por persona". |
| `prefixIcon` | `IconType` |  | Decorative icon before the input. |
| `suffixIcon` | `IconType` |  | Decorative icon after the input. |
| `action` | `ReactNode` |  | One button at the end, for an action that belongs to the field: Buscar, Copiar. |
| `children` (required) | `ReactNode` |  | The `Input`. |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Accessibility

- **The `Field` label names the input;** text addons are plain visible text read in order, icon addons are hidden from assistive technology.
- **One focus ring.** The input keeps its own focus ring and rises above the addons so it is never clipped.
- The group is 44 px high and the border between parts is a single line with 3:1 contrast. The action is a normal 44 px button.
- Addon text meets 4.5:1 on its tinted background in both modes.

## Content

- Short: one or two words. Put units after the number, symbols before.
